WITH
  errors AS (
    SELECT event_date, count(*) AS error_count
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND platform = 'IOS'
      AND event_name IN (__ALL_ERROR_EVENTS__)
    GROUP BY event_date
  ),
  sessions AS (
    SELECT event_date, count(*) AS session_count
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND platform = 'IOS'
      AND event_name = 'session_start'
    GROUP BY event_date
  )
SELECT
  s.event_date AS time,
  round(coalesce(e.error_count, 0) * 1.0 / greatest(s.session_count, 1), 4) AS errors_per_session
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN errors e ON s.event_date = e.event_date
ORDER BY time

SELECT event_date AS time, uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS same_day_uninstalls FROM analytics_events WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND platform = 'IOS' AND event_name = 'app_remove' AND (user_pseudo_id, event_date) IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id, event_date FROM analytics_events WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}' AND event_name = 'first_open' AND platform = 'IOS') GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date

SELECT event_date AS time, uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS same_day_uninstalls FROM analytics_events WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}' AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}') AND platform = 'ANDROID' AND event_name = 'app_remove' AND (user_pseudo_id, event_date) IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id, event_date FROM analytics_events WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}' AND event_name = 'first_open' AND platform = 'ANDROID') GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date

WITH
  installs AS (
    SELECT user_pseudo_id, event_date
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND platform = 'IOS'
      AND event_name = 'first_open'
  ),
  install_counts AS (
    SELECT event_date, count(*) AS install_count
    FROM installs
    GROUP BY event_date
  ),
  same_day_uninstalls AS (
    SELECT a.event_date, uniqExact(a.user_pseudo_id) AS uninstall_count
    FROM analytics_events a
    INNER JOIN installs i ON a.user_pseudo_id = i.user_pseudo_id AND a.event_date = i.event_date
    WHERE a.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND a.event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND a.event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND a.platform = 'IOS'
      AND a.event_name = 'app_remove'
    GROUP BY a.event_date
  )
SELECT
  ic.event_date AS time,
  round(coalesce(sdu.uninstall_count, 0) * 100.0 / ic.install_count, 2) AS same_day_uninstall_pct
FROM install_counts ic
LEFT JOIN same_day_uninstalls sdu ON ic.event_date = sdu.event_date
ORDER BY time
